name: AprilTag 3
summary: C library for detecting AprilTag fiducial markers and estimating the 6-DoF pose of each tag relative to a calibrated camera. Ships several tag families and Python bindings.
why_it_matters: The cheapest way to define goal B or anchor a drift-prone estimator in a close area: print tags, place them at A, B or on walls, and get a camera-relative pose with no map.
hackathon_notes: License BSD-2-Clause (LICENSE.md read via gh api; GitHub reports NOASSERTION). Last push 2026-08. Builds with CMake in minutes, Python bindings available. Needs camera intrinsics, so calibrate on Day 1. Pose ambiguity on small or far tags at near-frontal views is the known gotcha; use tag bundles or larger tags for the goal marker.

name: apriltag_ros (ROS 2)
summary: ROS 2 node that wraps the AprilTag library, subscribes to a rectified image and camera info, and publishes tag detections and TF transforms.
why_it_matters: Gets fiducial poses into a ROS 2 graph in one launch file, so a planner can treat 'tag id N in view' as goal B or feed tag-relative pose to the autopilot.
hackathon_notes: License MIT (gh api), last push 2026-11. Use this for ROS 2; AprilRobotics/apriltag_ros is the older ROS 1 wrapper (last push 2024-06). Publish the tag TF, then convert to LANDING_TARGET or to a local-frame goal. Frame conventions (camera optical vs body) are the usual time sink.

name: realsense-ros
summary: ROS 2 wrapper for RealSense depth cameras (D400 series), publishing stereo IR, depth, colour and IMU topics. The ROS 1 wrapper and the T265 tracking camera support live on legacy branches.
why_it_matters: The D435i / D455 are the common stereo + IMU input for VIO (OpenVINS, cuVSLAM) and depth for obstacle mapping on small indoor drones. Intel named them as the T265 successor when tracking cameras were discontinued.
hackathon_notes: License Apache-2.0 (gh api); repo moved from IntelRealSense to realsenseai, last push 2026-11. T265 is end of life (Intel EOL notice, sales stopped 2022), so do not plan on one unless the organisers hand it out. For VIO, turn the IR emitter off or use the IR stream with emitter off, otherwise the dot pattern corrupts feature tracking. IMU on D435i is unsynchronised with images by default; check unite_imu and timestamps.

name: smfeval
summary: Python tool that scores an odometry estimate together with its reported covariance (NEES, scale gap, coverage, proper scoring rules), plus a pairwise test that flags overconfidence between two filters without ground truth.
why_it_matters: Direct way to check whether the covariance a VIO or LIO stack publishes can be trusted before a planner or EKF2 consumes it. Ships covariance exporters for FAST-LIO2, Faster-LIO, Point-LIO and I2EKF-LO.
hackathon_notes: License Apache-2.0 (gh api), created 2026-05. Depends only on NumPy and SciPy. README example (not run here): FAST-LIO2 on Oxford Spires christ-church-03 gives median NEES 1.04e3 vs calibrated 2.37, about 21x too tight per axis, 90% coverage 0.000. Use it on Day 1 recordings to set an honest covariance inflation before feeding VISION_POSITION_ESTIMATE.

name: Bitcraze positioning_dataset
summary: Scripts and recordings that measure the accuracy and jitter of the Crazyflie Lighthouse positioning system against a Qualisys motion-capture reference, in crossing-beam and EKF modes.
why_it_matters: Gives a measured, not marketed, error budget for a cheap indoor absolute-position source; useful as a reference if the hackathon arena has Lighthouse base stations.
hackathon_notes: No license in gh api; last push 2021-03. Read it for numbers and method, not as a dependency. Companion to Taffanel et al. 2021 (about 2-4 cm mean error vs mocap).

name: livox-mid360-slam-evaluation
summary: Community benchmark of KISS-ICP, DLIO, FAST-LIO2 and GLIM on Livox Mid-360 data (TIERS indoor dataset plus own VICON-tracked UAV flights), run in ROS 2 Humble and scored with evo.
why_it_matters: One of the few open comparisons of LiDAR-inertial odometry on the sensor small indoor drones actually carry, with the pipeline gotchas (point timestamps, clock offsets) written down.
hackathon_notes: License MIT (gh api), last push 2026-09, 12 stars, single author, not peer reviewed. Reported UAV APE RMSE: GLIM (GPU) 0.040 m, DLIO 0.096 m, FAST-LIO2 0.112 m, KISS-ICP 0.123 m; ground truth was the Pixhawk EKF fused with VICON, so it is not raw mocap. Main value: the bag-conversion and timestamp pitfalls.

name: vrpn_mocap
summary: ROS 2 VRPN client that turns motion-capture rigid bodies (VICON, OptiTrack and other VRPN devices) into pose topics.
why_it_matters: If the venue has motion capture, this is the shortest path from mocap to a ROS 2 pose that MAVROS can forward to EKF2 / EKF3 as external vision, which turns localization into a solved problem and frees time for planning.
hackathon_notes: License MIT (gh api), last push 2026-09, CI for Humble through Rolling. Remap the pose to /mavros/vision_pose/pose, and convert ENU to NED once (MAVROS does it for vision_pose). Mocap latency is low but check EKF2_EV_DELAY anyway.
